parsed.name: HDF5数据文件
parsed.description: 一种用于实验室中保存、组织和交换科学成像与测量数据的 HDF5 数据文件。常用于归档多维数据、元数据及分析结果，便于后续读取、共享和处理。
parsed.description_en: An HDF5 data file used in laboratories to store, organize, and exchange scientific imaging and measurement data. It is commonly used to archive multidimensional datasets, metadata, and analysis results for later reading, sharing, and processing.

actions.description: 获取文件指针或底层文件句柄
actions.description_en: Get the file pointer or underlying file handle.
